scenarios.name: altar-lifts-devotion-to-five-before-type-change
scenarios.why: Purphoros, a one-pip red permanent, a two-pip one and a one-pip one total devotion 4; Altar of the Pantheon adds one to every devotion, making it 5, so Purphoros is a creature.

scenarios.name: without-the-altar-devotion-stays-four
scenarios.why: Same board minus the Altar: devotion to red is only 4, so Purphoros stays a non-creature enchantment.
